svg.aria-label: Systems architecture diagram. Channels feed the application layer, which passes requests needing judgement into the AI layer. Inside the AI layer a request is assembled, sent to the model, checked and acted on, drawing on memory, a model gateway and tools. The AI layer reads and writes business systems and data infrastructure, and the answer returns to the application.
svg.text: the only part that gets built
